goal: Allow block templates to include transactions that bring block weight or sigops exactly to limits
Prevents leaving valid block capacity unused and dropping transactions that fit consensus boundaries
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Concept approval to match consensus limits so pools do not need to patch templates themselves (ismaelsadeeq)
Objection: off-by-one errors risk producing invalid blocks and losing the reward for tiny fee gains (ajtowns)
Author added boundary tests and clarified miner budget docs, awaiting objector follow-up

categories.name: mining
why: P3 because the fee upside from fitting an extra transaction at exact limit boundaries is tiny
Aligning template building with consensus limits is correct but brings marginal real-world benefit
